sql: SELECT julianday(m.STOP) - julianday(m.START) FROM medications m JOIN patients p ON p.patient = m.PATIENT WHERE p.first = 'Elly' AND p.last = 'Koss' AND m.DESCRIPTION = 'Acetaminophen 160 MG'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.PATIENT), c.DESCRIPTION FROM encounters e JOIN careplans c ON c.PATIENT = e.PATIENT WHERE e.REASONDESCRIPTION = 'Second degree burn' AND c.REASONDESCRIPTION = 'Second degree burn' GROUP BY c.DESCRIPTION

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN p.gender = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(p.patient) FROM encounters e JOIN patients p ON p.patient = e.PATIENT WHERE e.REASONDESCRIPTION = 'Contact dermatitis' AND substr(e.DATE, 1, 4) = '2010'
SELECT DISTINCT m.DESCRIPTION FROM medications m JOIN patients p ON p.patient = m.PATIENT WHERE p.first = 'Joye' AND p.last = 'Homenick'
SELECT DISTINCT c.START FROM careplans c JOIN patients p ON p.patient = c.PATIENT WHERE p.maiden = 'Adams'
SELECT DISTINCT c.ID FROM careplans c JOIN patients p ON p.patient = c.PATIENT WHERE p.birthplace = 'Pembroke MA US'
SELECT DISTINCT p.first, p.last FROM careplans c JOIN patients p ON p.patient = c.PATIENT WHERE c.DESCRIPTION = 'Diabetic diet'
SELECT DISTINCT p.first, p.last FROM medications m JOIN patients p ON p.patient = m.PATIENT WHERE m.DESCRIPTION = 'Penicillin V Potassium 250 MG' AND substr(m.START, 1, 4) >= '1948'
SELECT DISTINCT p.first, p.last FROM conditions c JOIN patients p ON p.patient = c.PATIENT WHERE c.DESCRIPTION = 'Cystitis'
SELECT DISTINCT c.DESCRIPTION FROM careplans c JOIN patients p ON p.patient = c.PATIENT WHERE p.first = 'Major' AND p.last = 'D''Amore'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN p.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(p.patient) FROM conditions c JOIN patients p ON p.patient = c.PATIENT WHERE c.DESCRIPTION = 'Viral sinusitis (disorder)'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN p.gender = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(p.patient) FROM medications m JOIN patients p ON p.patient = m.PATIENT WHERE m.DESCRIPTION = 'Penicillin V Potassium 250 MG'
SELECT DISTINCT c.DESCRIPTION FROM careplans c JOIN patients p ON p.patient = c.PATIENT WHERE p.address = '179 Sydni Roads Taunton MA 02780 US'
SELECT DISTINCT c.DESCRIPTION FROM careplans c JOIN patients p ON p.patient = c.PATIENT WHERE p.ssn = '999-15-3685'

SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN p.deathdate IS NULL THEN (julianday(substr(datetime('now'), 1, 10)) - julianday(p.birthdate)) / 365 ELSE (julianday(p.deathdate) - julianday(p.birthdate)) / 365 END) FROM conditions c JOIN patients p ON p.patient = c.PATIENT WHERE c.DESCRIPTION = 'Hypertension' AND p.gender = 'M'
SELECT DISTINCT p.first, p.last FROM observations o JOIN patients p ON p.patient = o.PATIENT WHERE o.DESCRIPTION = 'Body Weight' AND o.VALUE = 61.97 AND o.UNITS = 'kg'
SELECT DISTINCT p.birthdate FROM medications m JOIN patients p ON p.patient = m.PATIENT WHERE p.gender = 'M' AND m.DESCRIPTION = 'Penicillin V Potassium 250 MG' LIMIT 5
